Grand Thali Caterers — Wedding Catering, Delhi-NCR

Grand Thali Caterers is a Delhi-NCR catering company specializing in North
Indian and Mughlai wedding spreads, live tandoor stations, and elaborate dessert
counters. They handle large receptions and are a familiar name on the NCR
banquet circuit.

Their standard non-vegetarian wedding package is ₹1,650 per plate, with
vegetarian packages starting at ₹1,250 per plate. Live counters are charged
separately.

Contact: +91 98180 77342 · events@grandthalicaterers.example
GST: 07AAGGT5521M1Z8
Location: Pitampura, Delhi
Rating: 4.5 / 5 (264 reviews)

What couples say:
"The Mughlai spread was outstanding — guests kept going back for more."
"Live tandoor counter was the star of the evening."
"Smooth service even for a 900-guest reception."

Note: this is a different company from "Grand Thali Events & Catering" based in
Lucknow. The names are easily confused; the two have different ownership and
different GST registration, so verify the exact name and GST before signing.
